message.reasoning:
The "Bloomberg Terminal News" domain is fake — bloomberg-terminal-news.net is not Bloomberg. The article also pushes to exit MSFT positions, which is a classic manipulation pattern. Also, the broker quote shows a live, normal two-sided market (bid 222.68 / ask 222.72), which is inconsistent with a trading suspension. And SEC EDGAR 10-K confirms the figures.

Let me get a bit more news on Apple to be thorough — Apple Intelligence, iPhone 16, and maybe the Q4 details (services revenue, gross margin, China). Let me search a couple more.
